programme.title: Chip la terreur
programme.desc: Spencer se bat contre le frère de Chuck, Chip.

programme.title: Banni
programme.desc: Les intrusions intempestives de Ti-bo dans l'appartement de Spencer et de Carly agacent cette dernière au point qu'elle lui en interdit l'accès. Le voilà banni des lieux ! Pour se venger, il en fait de même avec Carly et la bannit du Smoothie Groovy.

programme.title: Jai perdu ma tête à Vegas
programme.desc: La mère de Sam a été arrêtée à Las Vegas. Sam va devoir trouver deux mille cinq cent dollars pour payer la caution. Toute l'équipe part donc pour Vegas.

programme.title: Sauvez Carly
programme.desc: Sam retrouve Dana, une amie qui vient de sortir de prison. Elle présente Carly à cette amie, qui l'invite à une fête. Carly se rend à cette fête, mais les relations avec Dana restent difficiles du fait de leur caractère.

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: Des amis pour Spencer
programme.desc: En faisant la liste des invités pour l'anniversaire de Spencer, Carly et ses amis se rendent compte qu'il n'a pas d'amis de son âge. Ils se donnent alors pour mission de lui en trouver.

programme.title: Le vol
programme.desc: Sam a perdu son ordinateur portable. Carly et Freddie tentent de l'aider à le chercher. Spencer retrouve des tickets du Funk E. Fester's et décide de remporter le plus gros lot, Murray, le dauphin magique.

programme.title: Au revoir -- Première Partie
programme.desc: Carly doit aller au bal avec son père, mais celui-ci ne peut pas. Elle demande à Spencer de l'accompagner, mais il est malade.

programme.title: Au revoir
programme.desc: Carly doit aller au bal avec son père, mais celui-ci ne peut pas. Elle demande à Spencer de l'accompagner, mais il est malade.

programme.title: Que le spectacle commence
programme.desc: Carly est accusée pour une des sottises de Sam. Madame Briggs leur fait alors organiser les essais pour les nouveaux talents. Avec l'aide de Freddie, ils filment les auditions.

programme.title: Jadore Jack
programme.desc: Carly craque sur un garçon à l'école nommé Jake. Il est cool et sexy. Puisqu'elle l'aime bien, elle l'invite à auditionner sur son site. Malheureusement, elle comprend un peu tard que Jake est le pire chanteur du monde !

programme.title: Recherche Téléspectateurs
programme.desc: Carly et Sam se battent contre Freddie et Spencer pour décider de qui aura le meilleur plan pour rameuter les foules sur iCarly. La situation dégénère quand tous leur plans tournent à la catastrophe.

programme.title: Nevelocity
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie veulent qu'une critique de leur émission soit faite sur "Nevelocity", un site très populaire qui poste des critiques sur d'autres sites et émissions en ligne.

programme.title: Carly veut rester avec Spencer
programme.desc: Le grand-père de Carly et Spencer leur fait une visite surprise. Il est préoccupé par le fait que Spencer soit trop irresponsable et fainéant pour être le tuteur de Carly.

programme.title: La Nuit Des Morts-Vivants 3D
programme.desc: En arrivant au cimetière pour l'enterrement de leur tante, Barb et son frère Johnny sont surpris de ne trouver personne. Leur étonnement vire à la panique lorsqu'ils découvrent que le cimetière est envahi par des zombies qui les pourchassent.

programme.title: Seisme Imminent
programme.desc: Un pirate informatique mécontent utilise le fils rebelle du président d'une grande société de logiciels pour créer Havoc.

programme.title: Mémoires diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Je suis une légende
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une épidémie ravage la Terre, la population périt ou se transforme en une sorte de zombie vivant dans l'obscurité. Le docteur Robert Morgan est le seul survivant en bonne santé de la planète. Sa vie, routinière pour assurer sa survie, se déroule ainsi : il élimine les créatures nocturnes le jour et veille à la sécurité de sa maison, pour être protégé la nuit. Il souffre de l'absence de sa femme et de sa fille bien-aimées, emportées par l'épidémie, et lutte contre sa solitude pour préserver sa santé mentale. Lorsqu'il découvre Ruth Collins, contaminée, il utilise son sang pour la guérir et devient le dernier espoir de la Terre pour les autres survivants infectés. Mais l'ordre de cette nouvelle société est terrifiant.

programme.title: Le Miracle de Noël
programme.desc: Une famille qui ne manque de rien mais dont les membres peinent à communiquer vit un drame lorsqu'elle perd tous ses biens matériels. La famille est alors accueillie par un producteur de sapins de Noël, qui leur offre l'hospitalité et leur apprend le vrai sens de Noël et de la famille.

programme.title: Les aventures d'Elf Man
programme.desc: Le Père Noël envoie un de ses elfes pour aider deux frères à arrêter des voleurs qui prévoient d'entrer dans leur maison. Ils découvrent qu'Elf-Man est un vrai super-héros. Ensemble, ils devront arrêter les voleurs pour avoir le Noël dont ils ont rêvé.

programme.title: Un quartier totalement wouf !
programme.desc: Alors que tout le monde est parti en voyage de ski, le voisin de Robert embauche deux voleurs pour voler la dernière invention de celui-ci. Les chiens du quartier utiliseront les inventions de Robert pour mettre en place une maison d'horreurs pour les voleurs.

programme.title: Un Noël en Alaska
programme.desc: Lorsque la femme d'affaires Jennifer apprend que ses parents seront absents pendant les vacances de fin d'année, elle décide de quitter sa vie animée de citadine à San Francisco, pour visiter l'auberge de sa grand-mère en Alaska dont elle a héritée.

programme.title: Voisin contre voisin
programme.desc: Un optométriste rigide et traditionnel entre en rivalité avec son voisin, déterminé à orner sa maison avec autant de décorations lumineuses que possible pour qu'on la voie de l'espace.

programme.title: Dahmer le Cannibale
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie, Dahmer raconte l'histoire du célèbre serial-killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

programme.title: Burner
programme.desc: Kiki, mère célibataire tout juste sortie de prison, pense enfin pouvoir repartir à zéro avec sa fille. Mais le retour de son ex, un dealer violent, fait voler sa nouvelle vie en éclats. Pour se sauver elle-même et protéger sa fille, Kiki doit trouver un moyen de se débarrasser de son ex… et de s'en tirer sans être inquiétée.

programme.title: The Survivalist
programme.desc: Après qu'un virus mortel a décimé l'humanité, un ancien agent du FBI protège une jeune femme naturellement immunisée. Traquée par un gang dirigé par un dangereux psychopathe qui veut exploiter son immunité, elle représente peut-être le dernier espoir de sauver le monde.

programme.title: L'Attaque du requin à cinq têtes
programme.desc: Un requin à quatre têtes terrorise les côtes de Porto Rico. Pour attirer les touristes, un propriétaire d'aquarium envoie une équipe le capturer vivant. Mais lorsque la créature, blessée, développe une cinquième tête, la chasse tourne au carnage.

programme.title: La canne
programme.desc: Dans une salle de classe, les enfants attendent l'arrivée de leur nouvelle institutrice.

programme.title: Heurts
programme.desc: Fred, trente cinq ans, et Lisa, quarante cinq ans, s'aiment et essaient désespérément de faire un enfant. Mais en ce jour où Lisa fête son anniversaire et accuse la différence d'âge entre elle et Fred, celui-ci s'échappe pour une raison inconnue. Restée seule, Lisa va se laisser entraîner dans le tourbillon de son passé, et provoquer des heurts irrémédiables...

programme.title: Eric Rohmer et la pédagogie
programme.desc: Eric Rohmer, dans la salle de la Cinémamecque présente son court métrage « Véronique et son cancre » et sous une forme géométrique évoque les difficultés de la transmission et de la pédagogie.

programme.title: Blue
programme.desc: Une femme est éveillée la nuit. À proximité, un ensemble de décors de théâtre se niche, dévoilant deux paysages alternatifs. Sur le drap bleu de la femme, une lueur de lumière reflète et illumine son royaume d'insomnie.

programme.title: Breathing
programme.desc: Au lever du soleil, sur le toit de verre de la fondation, Aurélie Dupont interprète le solo « Ekstasis », chorégraphié par Martha Graham et ré-imaginé par Virginie Mécène. Une danse suspendue, entre ciel et mer, où la performance évolue à mesure que le jour se lève.

programme.title: Trois petits points
programme.desc: Une petite couturière attend son mari parti à la guerre.

programme.title: Rhapsodie pour un pot-au-feu
programme.desc: Trois générations d'une même famille cohabitent sous le même toit dans une chorégraphie désaccordée. La mère, chef d'orchestre de la famille, tente en vain de les réunir à table pour le dîner.

programme.title: Floating in my mind
programme.desc: Un film qui raconte l'histoire de la vie, de rencontres, de souvenirs...

programme.title: Le dernier jour d'un condamné
programme.desc: Camille, une jeune lycéenne, est en pleines révisions. Lassée par son travail, Camille jette un œil dans le frigidaire et y trouve un homard vivant. Se prenant d'affection pour l'animal, l'adolescente décide de lui faire vivre les plus belles heures de son existence...

programme.title: A Shadow of blue
programme.desc: Un soir d'automne, dans un parc situé au milieu d'une ville morne, une petite fille assise sur un banc, nous fait partager plusieurs visions d'une même réalité.

programme.title: Totems
programme.desc: Un bûcheron travaille dans la forêt quand un arbre s'écrase sur lui et l'immobilise. La détresse réveille alors l'animal caché en lui…

programme.title: Pim Poum le petit Panda
programme.desc: Pour Daniel, Pim-Poum le panda c'est presque le rôle de sa vie. Presque, parce que dans le fond ce qui l'intéresse c'est d'être payé. En compagnie de Lucie et Caro, et sous la direction de Marie-Agnès, ils vont se présenter devant leur public : un groupe d'enfants de 5 ans. Alors que la représentation aurait pu bien se dérouler, les interêts de chacun, l'interprétation des personnages et la mise en scène font virer le spectacle au désastre.

programme.title: Le distributeur d'aurores boréales
programme.desc: Lola collectionne les horloges cassées depuis qu'elle a perdu sa mère. Une nuit, elle découvre que l'une d'elle est hantée... Peut-on tomber amoureux d'un fantôme? Que se passerait-il s'il revenait dans la réalité ?

programme.title: Regards libres
programme.desc: Des enfants observent, commentent et critiquent un tableau.

programme.title: Tomatl, chronique de la fin d'un monde
programme.desc: La tomate fut découverte par les européens en même temps que le Nouveau Monde. Les Aztèques léguèrent cette plante, qui couvre aujourd'hui le tiers des surfaces de la planète...

programme.title: Kroak
programme.desc: Kroak part pêcher tôt le matin. De son baluchon, il sort tout une panoplie d'outils et attend le poisson qui ne vient pas. Lorsque ça mord enfin, c'est un refrigérateur qui sort de l'eau, puis une table dressée et enfin un drôle de poisson.

programme.title: Personne ne s'aimera jamais comme on s'aime
programme.desc: Pauline et Noham s'aiment à la folie. Quand la mère de Pauline lui annonce qu'elles déménagent à Paris, Pauline, incapable de se séparer de Noham, décide de rester vivre dans sa ville natale. Seulement voilà, Pauline n'a que dix ans…

programme.title: Le bûcheron des mots
programme.desc: Dans un pays où les habitants se nourrissent, au sens propre, de lettres et de mots cueillis dans les arbres, la lecture est vitale s'ils ne veulent pas mourir... d'ennui. Mais certains livres sont interdits à cause de leur contenu émotionnel et des transformations physiques qu'ils provoquent. Nadal, un bûcheron des mots, fait une rencontre qui change définitivement sa vie...

programme.title: Circuit marine
programme.desc: Un bateau en haute mer, les marins pêchent, mangent, boivent...et chantent. Le chat regarde le perroquet, le perroquet regarde le joli poisson dans son bocal, le chat regarde le poisson... Qui mangera qui ?

programme.title: La grande migration
programme.desc: Les aventures humoristiques d'un oiseau migrateur qui perd ses congénères dans les nuages...

programme.title: Una furtiva lagrima
programme.desc: Ultime voyage d'un poisson qui chante son propre requiem, depuis la vente à la poissonnerie jusque dans la poêle à frire.

programme.title: Fatigués d'être beaux
programme.desc: Deux cow-boys partent à la recherche d'une balle qu'ils ont tirée dans le désert.

programme.title: Pépé le morse
programme.desc: Sur la plage sombre et venteuse, Mémé prie, Maman hurle, les frangines s'en foutent, Lucas est seul. Pépé était bizarre comme type, maintenant il est mort.

programme.title: Les chiens isolés
programme.desc: Sur une plateforme pétrolière, une histoire d'amitié entre deux ouvriers se voit compromise par la démence paranoïaque de l'un deux.

programme.title: Shudo
programme.desc: Deux samurais s'affrontent sur un champ de bataille ravagé par la guerre. Absorbés par leur orgueil, ils se lancent dans un duel alimenté par leur ressentiment.

programme.title: Le portefeuille
programme.desc: Un jour, un homme trouve un portefeuille par terre. Ou bien, ne l'a-t-il pas vu ? Il décide de le rendre à son propriétaire et aussi de le garder pour lui.

programme.title: L'évasion
programme.desc: Un homme est en prison. Son compagnon de cellule est torturé jusqu'à la mort. Quand ses geôliers viennent le chercher à son tour, il parvient à s'enfuir dans l'enceinte du bâtiment. Geste désespéré car il s'agit d'un vrai labyrinthe. Il échappe pourtant à ses poursuivants jusqu'au toit de l'immeuble. Du haut des miradors, un militaire le tient en joue. Là il exprime devant eux toute la mesure de sa liberté.

programme.title: Nimbus Machina
programme.desc: Le désert, le vent, un rail. Une étrange machine passe et crache de gigantesques nuages de vapeur et de suie.

programme.title: Les voiles du partage
programme.desc: Etienne Bernard part en exil dans les terres du Nord pour y chercher l'aventure. A peine arrivé, il est plongé directement dans l'ambiance : la ville est aux mains d'une mafia locale qui fait du trafic de chars à voile...

programme.title: Betty's blues
programme.desc: Un jeune guitariste tente sa chance dans un vieux bar de blues de Louisiane. Il évoque la légende de Blind Boogie Jones, dans la Nouvelle Orléans des années 1920, une histoire d'amour et de vengeance...

programme.title: Ephémères
programme.desc: Sur le mur d'une vieille maison, un éphémère cherche sa place parmi les photos de famille.

programme.title: Petit bonhomme
programme.desc: Henri a neuf ans pas tout à fait et demi. Le temps d'un après-midi à la piscine, il décide de suivre les conseils de son père pour séduire la petite Rachel dont il est fou amoureux.

programme.title: Billy the Killy
programme.desc: Un documentaire sur la façon dont Martin Gretschmann compose un chef-d'œuvre de musique binaire. Une boite à rythme lance l'installation tandis qu'une enclume la stoppe net. Entre les deux, une succession d'images dont une poupée qui adresse un clin d'œil à Kill Bill…

programme.title: Train de vie
programme.desc: Dans une gare perdue en pleine cambrousse, le retard d'un train va amener trois personnages à sortir de leur isolement quotidien.

programme.title: T'étais où quand Michaël Jackson est mort ?
programme.desc: Paris, quelques jours après la mort du roi de la pop, quelques jours avant noël, une rencontre les bouscule, Elle et Lui, à l'arrière d'un taxi. Ils roulent au milieu des lumières de la ville, le temps d'un désir.

programme.title: La révolution des crabes
programme.desc: Les crabes de l'estuaire de la Gironde ont un sérieux handicap : ils ne peuvent pas changer de direction et sont condamnés à marcher toute leur vie suivant la même ligne droite. Comment vivent-ils ce tragique destin ?

programme.title: Des millions de larmes
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'une rencontre dans un café-restaurant désert le long d'une route. Un homme d'une soixantaine d'années qui attend là. Une jeune femme fait son entrée, un sac sur le dos, sa vie dedans et la mine passablement fatiguée. Il lui propose de l'avancer. Elle accepte.

programme.title: Manipulation Criminelle
programme.desc: Theo Abrams est un ancien pompier du Cap souffrant d'un grave syndrome de stress post-traumatique, incapable de reprendre le travail en raison du traumatisme psychologique subi lors d'une mission de sauvetage qui a mal tourné. De plus en plus frustré et instable, Theo voit son monde basculer lorsqu'un matin, il se réveille à côté du cadavre de sa femme, sans aucun souvenir de ce qui s'est passé et avec toutes les preuves suggérant qu'il l'a tuée.

programme.title: SuperGrid
programme.desc: Dans un avenir où une peste a infecté une grande partie de la population deux frères sont chargés de se rendre au Canada pour récupérer un mystérieux colis.

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Une femme est kidnappée et forcée de participer à des combats souterrains d'élite et doit se frayer un chemin vers la liberté.

programme.title: The Agent
programme.desc: Jong-seong, un agent fantôme nord-coréen, interrompt une vente d'armes illégale à Berlin. Un agent nord-coréen notoire met à l'épreuve la loyauté de tous les participants alors que Jong-seong se prépare à faire le sacrifice ultime.

programme.title: Imagine
programme.desc: Une rock-star vieillissante ne souhaite pas changer ses habitudes de vie, jusqu'à ce que son agent lui fasse ouvrir une lettre gardée secrète pendant 40 ans, écrite de la main de John Lennon, le célèbre membre des Beatles. Suite à cette découverte inattendue, Danny Collins va chercher à redécouvrir sa famille et à trouver l'amour.

programme.title: J'aurais Voulu Etre Un Danseur
programme.desc: François mène une vie paisible et heureuse avec sa ravissante épouse et son jeune fils jusquà ce qu'il découvre pour la première fois la comédie musicale "Singin' in the rain". Hypnotisé, il quitte sa famille pour se consacrer à sa nouvelle et dévorante passion pour les claquettes. Mais il ne sait pas encore que son père et son grand-père ont fait la même chose des années auparavant...

programme.title: The Sherlock Holmes: Valley Of Fear
programme.desc: Un violoniste introverti et fumeur rencontre un médecin et le plonge dans le monde criminel.

programme.title: Only The Brave
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. En juin 2013, les pompiers d'élite de Prescott en Arizona ont tenté d'éteindre un gigantesque incendie qui a coûté la vie de 19 d'entre-eux.

programme.title: Fiction à l'américaine
programme.desc: Lassé de voir le système profiter des divertissements « noirs » basés sur des tropes offensants, un romancier frustré décide d'écrire son propre livre « noir », qui le propulse au cœur de l'hypocrisie qu'il méprise.

programme.title: Blackwater Lane
programme.desc: Une femme passe en voiture à côté d'un automobiliste en panne dont on découvre plus tard qu'il a été assassiné. Après une série d'événements terrifiants, la femme devient convaincue qu'elle est la prochaine victime du tueur.

programme.title: The Samaritan
programme.desc: Après avoir purgé 25 ans de prison pour le meurtre de son partenaire Eddy, Foley est libéré, déterminé à mener une vie honnête. Il trouve un travail et tente d'aller de l'avant, mais le fils vengeur d'Eddy, Ethan, le retrouve et le pousse à participer à une arnaque à haut risque.

programme.title: Ophelia
programme.desc: L'esprit singulier d'Ophélie capture l'affection de Hamlet. Pendant que la luxure et la trahison menacent le royaume, Ophélie se retrouve coincée entre le véritable amour et le contrôle de son propre destin.

programme.title: La Retraite de l'Amour
programme.desc: Jenny, créatrice de contenu, entre en conflit avec Nate, le frère de son patron, en promouvant Bloom écolo.

programme.title: L'Amour pour objectif
programme.desc: Rebecca aide l'ex-star du football Clive, réalisant qu'il pourrait faire partie de sa meilleure version.

programme.title: Piégée avec ma soeur
programme.desc: Une piscine va fermer pour un long week-end de vacances. Bree et sa sœur Joanna sont en difficulté.

programme.title: Soul Survivors
programme.desc: Après avoir failli mourir dans un accident de voiture dans lequel son petit ami y est resté, une étudiante reprend le cours de sa vie, mais semble se trouver dans une espèce d'état secondaire. Perdue entre le monde des vivants et celui des esprits, les fantômes de l'au-delà cherchent à l'emporter, pire encore, à utiliser son corps possédé pour pénétrer dans notre monde.

programme.title: Les messagers
programme.desc: Une famille quitte la ville animée de Chicago en faveur d'une nouvelle vie dans une ferme de tournesols isolée. Mais leur nouveau départ vire rapidement au cauchemar lorsqu'une série d'étranges événements les poussent à croire qu'ils ne sont pas seuls dans leur nouvelle maison.

programme.title: The Gate
programme.desc: Un arbre est enlevé du jardin de Glen et révèle un mystérieux trou qui mène à un portail et la chambre souterraine d'un mal terrifiant.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Un homme essaie de se débarrasser de visions horribles et commence à soupçonner que ce qu'il voit sont de sombres souvenirs d'enfance.

programme.title: Soul Survivors
programme.desc: Après avoir failli mourir dans un accident de voiture dans lequel son petit ami y est resté, une étudiante reprend le cours de sa vie, mais semble se trouver dans une espèce d'état secondaire. Perdue entre le monde des vivants et celui des esprits, les fantômes de l'au-delà cherchent à l'emporter, pire encore, à utiliser son corps possédé pour pénétrer dans notre monde.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Une nouvelle recrue des forces de police joue au chat et à la souris avec un psychopathe fou de la gâchette, obsédé par elle.

programme.title: Jonathan
programme.desc: Deux jumeaux mènent une vie normale dictée par une stricte routine. L'un le jour, l'autre la nuit.

programme.title: Shaolin Soccer
programme.desc: Lorsque Fung voit Sing, un moine, mettre en déroute des voyous avec un simple ballon, il a l'ingénieuse idée de créer une équipe de foot.

programme.title: La fille du Président
programme.desc: Samantha Mackenzie désire la même chose que n'importe quel étudiant : vivre loin de chez elle et de ses parents. Toutefois, ce sera plus compliqué que prévu, parce que la maison de Sam c'est la Maison Blanche et son père le président des États-Unis.

programme.title: Hold Up
programme.desc: Plusieurs braquages opérés par des gangs différents ont lieu simultanément dans la même banque. Un des otages tente de comprendre les raisons de cette troublante coïncidence. Mais en tombant sous le charme d'une guichetière aguicheuse, la tâche ne lui est pas facilitée...

programme.title: Basmati Blues
programme.desc: Linda, brillante scientifique américaine, est envoyée en Inde pour vendre le riz génétiquement modifié qu'elle a créé. Mais elle se rend compte qu'elle cause du tort aux fermiers qu'elle pensait aider. Lorsque l'amour s'en mêle, Linda est plus perdue que jamais.

programme.title: Ma super ex
programme.desc: Gauche, Matt voit sa rencontre avec Jenny (qui est en fait G-Girl) comme un cadeau. Mais quand il décide de rompre, il se retrouve confronté à une super-héroïne super rancunière.

programme.title: L'Amour à la dérive
programme.desc: Lors d'une croisière dans les Caraïbes, Jenny est abandonnée sur une plage avec son idole du rock and roll. Délireusement amoureuse de l'idée de passer du temps seule avec lui, elle parvient à cacher le fait qu'ils sont à deux pas de leur station balnéaire.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Prêt à tout pour trouver un sujet d'article intéressant, un journaliste suit une prostituée diplômée de Stanford et s'introduit dans le monde des escorts girls de luxe.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Une femme belle, dérangée et dangereuse devient obsédée par un homme marié récemment installé dans le quartier et sème le chaos dans tous les aspects de la vie du couple.

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: Un homme est retrouvé gravement blessé dans une chambre d'hôtel. Il avait fait appel à une agence d'escort-girls, le « Black Diamond ». L'équipe d'Hannah est chargée de l'enquête...

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: Un homme est retrouvé gravement blessé dans une chambre d'hôtel. Il avait fait appel à une agence d'escort-girls, le « Black Diamond ». L'équipe d'Hannah est chargée de l'enquête...

programme.title: La vie de bohème
programme.desc: Tous sont des artistes (peintres, musiciens, poètes...), tous sont destinés à la gloire, ce sont les beaux jours, la jeunesse. C'est La Vie De Bohême, la vie bohémienne. Mimi et Rodolphe se promènent dans les Jardins du Luxembourg. C'est le printemps. L'été apporte la Révolution de 1848. Rodolphe, le poète, est très déçu car personne ne veut publier ses vers. L'automne marque le début des mauvais jours. Les amis n'ont rien à brûler dans leur cheminée sauf eux-mêmes. Mimi a quitté Rodolphe car elle ne veut pas être un fardeau pour lui. En hiver, alors que la neige tombe, les amis fêtent Noël Mimi est devenue une femme entretenue elle est mourante et elle est toujours amoureuse de Rodolphe.

programme.title: The Happiness Playbook
programme.desc: Des étincelles jaillissent lorsqu'une journaliste infiltrée commence à tomber amoureuse du sujet de son reportage.

programme.title: Un hologramme pour le roi
programme.desc: Un homme accepte le job de sa vie dans le but de vendre une technologie d'hologramme à un monarque.

programme.title: Au Cœur des Sentiments
programme.desc: Deux sœurs se retrouvent dans la maison familiale et retrouvent espoir après la mort de leur père.

programme.title: Chien Milliardaire
programme.desc: Un enfant affronte des voleurs maladroits pour sauver un chien portant un butin de diamants.

programme.title: The Outcasts
programme.desc: Deux amis surmontent une humiliation causée par les filles cools au lycée.

programme.title: Un hologramme pour le roi
programme.desc: Un homme accepte le job de sa vie dans le but de vendre une technologie d'hologramme à un monarque.

programme.title: Le bal masqué de Noël
programme.desc: Lors d'un bal masqué, Julieanne est prise pour sa patronne, une femme élégante, par un homme d'affaires réputé distant. Elle poursuit la supercherie pendant les fêtes de Noël. Son objectif : le convaincre de devenir client, tout en profitant des joies de Noël, en compagnie de sa fille Nora. Mais lorsque les véritables motivations de Peter sont révélées, pourront-ils trouver le véritable amour dans ce monde féerique improvisé qu'ils ont créé ?

programme.title: Noël entre filles
programme.desc: Sarah, Cat et Riley se retrouvent dans leur maison d'enfance pour recréer la magie de Noël. À un tournant de leur vie, les trois amies découvrent que l'esprit des fêtes peut tout changer.

programme.title: Le nombre magique de Noël
programme.desc: À l'approche de Noël, un conseiller financier commence à voir un chiffre récurrent : 624. On lui dit que c'est un ange de Noël qui a exaucé son souhait. Elle dit que c'est une coïncidence statistique. Mais lorsqu'elle en découvre le sens, elle trouve l'amour.

programme.title: L'amour n'est jamais bien loin
programme.desc: Après une rupture médiatisée, Charley, fondatrice d'une application de rencontres, fait équipe avec Liam, expert marketing audacieux, pour sauver son entreprise. Ensemble, ils découvrent que l'amour était peut-être juste là.

programme.title: Un amour de photographe
programme.desc: Laura, assistante de galerie passionnée de photo, doit convaincre Shane, un artiste retiré du monde depuis dix ans, d'exposer ses clichés. En l'aidant à retrouver l'inspiration, elle pourrait aussi trouver sa propre voie.

programme.title: Le Sourire De Mona Lisa
programme.desc: En 1953, Katherine Watson, une jeune femme libre d'esprit, fraîchement diplômée de l'université de Bekerley, intègre la prestigieuse école pour filles de Wellesley pour enseigner l'histoire de l'art. Déterminée à affronter les mœurs dépassées de la société et de l'institution, elle va insuffler à ses étudiantes, dont Betty et Joan, l'envie de se dépasser et d'avoir le courage de mener l'existence qu'elles souhaitent réellement vivre.

programme.title: Think Like A Man Too
programme.desc: Les couples sont de retour pour un mariage à Las Vegas, mais ce qui devait être un week-end romantique vire en cauchemar lorsque leurs diverses mésaventures les amènent dans des situations compromettantes, qui menacent de faire tomber à l'eau le mariage.

programme.title: L'or de Curly
programme.desc: Mitch Robbins part avec son frère Glen, et son ami de toujours Phil Berquist à la recherche du trésor de Curly, un cowboys qu'il a connu autrefois.

programme.title: Les Indians 2
programme.desc: Les Indians doivent retrouver leur esprit d'équipe pour rester champions.

programme.title: Kids in America
programme.desc: Quand le principal d'un lycée abuse de son pouvoir pour restreindre la liberté d'expression à l'intérieur de l'établissement, un groupe de sept jeunes, encouragés par un professeur passionné, s'allient pour protester contre l'hypocrisie de leur administration.

programme.title: Une famille 2 en 1
programme.desc: Veuf, Frank se rend à une réunion d'anciens étudiants et y retrouve Helen, son ex-petite amie, elle aussi restée seule après le décès de son mari. Le courant passe immédiatement et le couple décide rapidement de s'installer ensemble.

programme.title: Mi-Temps Au Mitard

programme.title: Bryony Gordon On How People Pleasing Fuelled My OCD
programme.desc: Author and mental health advocate Bryony Gordon explores how people pleasing has fuelled parts of her OCD, alcoholism, and eating disorders over the years. Fearne and Bryony discuss the 'fawn' trauma response - appeasing others to stay safe - and chat about body image and the insecurities that have consumed them. Bryony reckons feeling 'too much' and 'not enough' are two sides of the same coin, and offers advice on how to confidently take up space.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Bling on the Bride
programme.desc: We are introduced to four planners from Austin, Texas, who collaborate to infuse their unique Texas style into every wedding they organize. Additionally, a planner from Southern California is passionate about creating dream weddings. Austin Planners:Kathie, Vivian, Jeff, and Kiley aim to transform a lakeside yacht club in Texas into a Moroccan beach resort for their couple, Lynsey and Seth. Since the bride and groom reside in Los Angeles, the planners must make decisions on color palettes, floral arrangements, and lounge furniture without direct input. Just hours before the wedding day, a hailstorm unexpectedly hits the lakeside location, adding to the challenges. Southern California Planner (Melissa Barrad): Melissa organizes an elegant wedding at a historical site in San Diego for her couple, Will and Kasey. Her primary concern is transitioning the formal ceremony setting into Kasey's envisioned reception ballroom within a tight timeframe. Despite the unusually chilly California night, the guests patiently await the celebration.

programme.title: April in Paris Bride
programme.desc: Wedding cake is important to every bride. But wedding planner David Tutera knows it has a deeper meaning to bride Kristina, who has struggled with an eating disorder. Kristina's fiancé wouldn't marry her until she was able to eat and enjoy the cake at their wedding. Now that Kristina is healthy, it's time to plan her April in Paris wedding. Trouble is, Kristina has everything from the Eiffel Tower to French poodles thrown into the mix! The bridesmaids chose their own dresses, and the reception venue is a hot tub resort an hour away. David creates a flower-filled fantasy of Parisian art and entertainment. Let them eat cake!

programme.title: Hawaiian Luau Bride
programme.desc: Bride Kristin went from a size 24 to a size 6 after having a stroke. Her fiancé stayed by her side through it all, and even lost 50 pounds himself! Now, Kristin wants her wedding to feel like she's at a Hawaiian luau. But her theme has become as tacky as a tiki torch. The flowers are fake, the bridesmaids are barefoot, and her backyard venue is hardly Hawaiian. Wedding planner David Tutera decides to show off his bride's new figure and her sweet nature, too. With fabulous fashion, flowers, and fire dancers David turns this bride's wedding into a real tropical dream.

programme.title: Shabby Chic Bride
programme.desc: Bride Candice Marie loves shabby chic. Her wedding theme has plenty of white, sparkle, and homey touches. Her thoughtful fiancé even made a shabby chic chandelier to hang over the sweetheart table. But most important of all to Candice Marie is the picture of her mother she wants to carry in her bridal bouquet. programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: As the tide rises in New Zealand's Northland Harbours, Stingrays and Eagle rays swim in to feast on shellfish. But they are not the top of the food chain. Only in New Zealand, and only in these harbours do Orca hunt rays. Trapped in the shallows, the rays breach the surface and swim for their lives, as the Orca pursue – with a highly evolved practice for avoiding the rays' stinging tail. As the tide ebbs, the once underwater world of Northland's mangroves surfaces and seethes. Twisted roots that moments ago sheltered fish are now exposed - a seafood platter for patient Herons, Spoonbills, and Shags.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Just north of New Zealand's biggest city, tens of thousands of fish school meters from the beach in one of the world's first marine reserves. Inside the Goat Island Reserve giant snapper can live for eighty years and crayfish grow to weigh 8 kilos. Both feed on the thousands of sea urchins that graze the kelp forest, maintaining a delicately balanced ecosystem. Like many of the reserve's inhabitants, they entrust their larvae to the ocean currents - so how do they find their way back to the reef when they take on their adult form and settle down?

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard

When disaster strikes and the male Sandagers Wrasse disappears, one of the harem of females undergoes a sex change to pick up the missing male's responsibilities. programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: Forests
programme.desc: Shrouded in myth and legend, the forests of Germany are world famous, thanks to the fairy tales of the Brothers Grimm. The strange creatures that actually live there are shown in the episode Forests of the four-part series Wild Germany. A lynx out hunting, red deer stags roar to call their harems together, wild boar forage in dead leaves looking for nuts. When one considers how densely populated it is, Germany is home to a surprising number of different species. Around one third of the country is covered in forest. Forests enters a world full of magic and shows the secretive inhabitants you won't see when out for a walk. Spring in the Black Forest brings out the cherry blossom. Not long now, and the fruit used to make the famous Black Forest Gâteau will appear. A doe has deposited its fawn in the high grass under the trees. Nearby, a vixen is on the look-out for food for her cubs. She would just about be able to handle the fawn ... Life in the forest is full of drama. Humans are rarely seen, the animal adventures take place behind a thick curtain of leaves. The wildcat and the lynx have managed to reconquer some regions from which they had long disappeared. For rare animals like black stork and stag beetle, the woods offer a last refuge. The best nature film-makers in Germany spent more than five years travelling the country from the Harz mountains to the Bavarian Forest, from Saxonian Switzerland to the Palatinate Forest, collecting material on the secret lives of forest dwellers.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. When she looks down into the water, gazing up at her is the cutest, most adorable, puffy-cheeked fish she's ever seen. It's love at first sight. Orange has to take him home.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! Berry Bitty City is decorated with colorful banners proclaiming the big event. Lemon works the hardest. For weeks she has watered her violets by day and sung to them at night, doing everything she can to win first prize. With the contest just a day away, Lemon is at her garden early.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry comes by to admire them and Blueberry is reminded that the new cookbook Strawberry ordered has arrived. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: The Rebel
programme.desc: “The culprit who is posing as a royal official is not stealing wealth. He is stealing the hearts and minds of your people, Your Majesty.” There was a divisive figure in the Joseon Dynasty who was a hero to the people but an enemy to the establishment. His name was Hong Gil-dong. King Yeonsangun had royal lineage but was reviled by his people while Hong Gil-gong was born as a slave but succeeded in winning over the hearts of the commoners.

programme.title: Find me in Memory
programme.desc: A love story between a man who remembers every second of his life and a woman who forgot her painful past.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.314
programme.desc: MOVNING is known for his trademark, consoling piano sounds that match beautifully with his calm vocals. He debuted in 2016 with the single “Life is a Rainbow” and then made himself known to the public in 2018 through the song “Everything I Love Will Make Me Cry.” The 2018 release also earned him the nicknames of “an artist that every listener should listen to” and “an artist that deserves to top all the music charts.” In June this year, MOVNING made its much-anticipated comeback with the song “Your Name, Youth.” With magnificent string sounds, this new release beautifully portrays “youth,” an age of uncertainty and turmoil, yet possibly the most precious thing in life. Tune in to I'm LIVE and feel the ultimate beauty of youth once again with MOVNING!Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter MOVNING! In this episode, MOVNING performs “Life is a Rainbow,” “Everything I Love Will Make Me Cry,” “Twilight of Youth,” “Your Name, Youth,” and more to nourish our souls.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.315
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is a band ready to touch our heart - TOUCHED! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet TOUCHED!TOUCHED is back on I'm LIVE 2 years after their first appearance and performs “Hi Bully,” “Alive,” “Shut Down,” “Love is Dangerous,” and more to show off their flawless musicality. TOUCHED is comprised of vocalist and guitarist Yunmin, drummer Kim Seung-bin, bassist John B. Kim, guitarist D.on, and keyboardist Chae Do-hyeon. With their intense sounds and wide spectrum of music, the quintet has been praised for opening a new era in the band music scene. They are also the first band to have won the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest and have taken home top prizes from many other music contests, mesmerizing both critics and general listeners.

programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.
